devdoc.details: Acceptance is immutable. Each sale/auction separately authenticates the artist's exact transaction terms; this registry does not claim collaborator, recovery, or estate capabilities.

acceptArtist(uint256,bytes32,uint256,uin.details: An artist may also accept directly with an empty signature. A nominated address is never presented as accepted, and a replaced nomination invalidates its previous signatures.

acceptArtist(uint256,bytes32,uint256,uin.notice: Anyone can relay an EOA/ERC1271 signature; the artist needs no funded transaction.
